verdict.rationale: Airwallex directly supports charging customers via 160+ local payment methods and multi-currency pricing (accepting in local currencies), and its multi-currency Wallet enables like-for-like settlement without forced FX conversion, explicitly marketed as eliminating FX fees versus traditional gateways that force home-currency settlement. Transfers/payouts and invoicing further round out the collect-and-settle flow, backed by first-party docs. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of actual FX rates charged and real-world transparency (e.g., third-party review of fee disclosure) beyond vendor documentation.
